focus: Design the perception stack for an autonomous vehicle that fuses data from cameras, LiDAR, and radar sensors, detects objects in 3D space, and tracks their movement in real-time.
scale: Predict object motion for path planning
durable: Process multi-camera feeds in real-time; Process LiDAR point clouds for 3D detection
async: Use BEV (Bird's Eye View) representations for fusion, Implement PointPillars or CenterPoint for LiDAR detection, Use temporal fusion for multi-frame tracking
store: Design an Autonomous Vehicle Perception System
